notes: imd/acc Sepolia test run 5 (chain 11155111): deploy only ProjectRegistry with the seven constructor arguments above. imd/acc pays traders cashback as staked IMD (sIMD), at each project's choice of 25-100 basis points (0.25%-1%) of each trade, funded from its existing trading fees. Only credits from listed projects earn points. This is the code intended for the mainnet registry with Sepolia settings: test run 4's registry (launch #1378, 0xfe4470a42df0e77f7efb1b2e8135134a9cd7d102) plus version 3 panel rules and owner-only applications from the mainnet Stacker launch's audit (#1409), for live application, listing and challenge trials before mainnet. The eight rules in docs/panel-rules-v2.md are each under 512 characters. Resolve the trader from valid router hookData, else the router's msgSender(), else sender only if it has no code; never credit an unresolved router. Qualifying fee outflow must cover cashback at every allowed setting; LP fees and returns to the trader, owner or team do not qualify. applyListing checks projectOwner before charging: a nonzero, well-formed owner() permits only that owner or the project itself (NotProjectOwner otherwise); a revert, malformed answer or zero means anyone may apply. The owner staticcall is capped at 30,000 gas and copies at most 32 bytes. The registry names test run 2's live Stacker 0x0457276D7b036818B3EddC1A4A3FCeda61e9314d (launch #1294) in questions and never calls it. That Stacker omits the mainnet InvalidTrader check, uses launch #1129's live TestIMD and TestSIMD, and already receives PLEA hook credits. No Stacker, TestIMD or TestSIMD is deployed. Each ask pays ORACLE_FEE(), read live from Intake v2 at 0xa43e6F75ee006411F79Ac1C84120606C2330DE82, in oracleAsset 0x44a1Cd38474FB1748400E7DEb5F8D786ccE3F89A (0.5 test IMD at the supplied snapshot). requestWithFailure asks one yes-or-no question with 15 seats and quorum 11. Anyone may challengeForBeneficiary a listed project after its 3600-second cooldown, posting a 5 test-IMD bond as well as the fee. onOracleResult (0x510379c7) accepts only the Intake, an open request made by this registry, and an unused answer signed by oracleSigner for this contract, with issuance checked against the ask using 300-second tolerance and at least 11 agreeing. Yes lists from that block or defends a listing, paying the bond to its beneficiary without restarting cooldown; no rejects or delists from that block and returns the challenge bond. onOracleFailure (0xa7980e31) only clears the question and returns any bond; expire clears it after a day or once the Intake completed it. Refused bond transfers accrue in bondOwed for claimBond(to). setBeneficiary allows a wallet change at most once per day and only with no open question. Questions are filed under chain 1 because the oracle has no Sepolia RPC; their text identifies Sepolia by chain 11155111. The registry has no owner, and its constructor makes no external call.
